info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Payments-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Retrieval API provides a comprehensive interface for accessing billing payment records for utility services. This endpoint allows users to efficiently retrieve detailed information regarding payments made towards their utility bills. Typical consumers of this API include utility companies and billing administrators who need to manage customer accounts and payment histories. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their billing processes and enhance customer service through timely payment information.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding payment transactions related to their billing accounts. Useful for understanding billing history and resolving discrepancies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment information related to billing. It must be formatted as JSON and should include relevant payment identifiers and any necessary filters to retrieve the desired payment data.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body in JSON format for the operations related to billing and payment retrieval.

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information related to the payment operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response of a successful payment operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed by an automated system.

Audit.description: Schema representing the audit information for a payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
